descriptions.dyeing-method-setup: The dyeing methods a batch may be run under, single or double, and the default one.
descriptions.dyeing-machine-profile: Every dyeing machine on the floor — capacity, nozzles, make, origin and what it is doing.
descriptions.dyeing-fin-and-g-quality-resp-emploee: The people answerable for dyeing finishing and for grey fabric quality.
descriptions.dyes-chemical-audit-recipe-setup: The chemical checks each buyer’s audit puts a recipe through.
descriptions.color-group-wise-rate-update: Dyeing rate per colour group — light, medium, dark — used when costing.
descriptions.dyeing-sc-party-rate: Agreed rate card per subcontract dyeing party and process.

machine.hint: Status is whether the machine is on the books; Prod. Status is what it is doing this morning. A machine that is not active cannot be reported as running.
machine.list_hint: The three lists the machine form selects from — the kinds of machine, the makes, and the sheds they stand in. Pick a list to edit it, or add to it.

colour.title: Dyeing Color Group
colour.hint: Every shade band, what a kilo costs to run in it, and whether a lab dip has to be approved first. Type over any box and Save writes the lot.
colour.footer: :count colour groups. Water and wash costs are per kilo and are carried into every costing run.

audit.title: Buyer Audit Item
audit.hint: Load a buyer to see the chemical checks their audit puts a recipe through. Type over Alter Item Name, mark the checks being dropped, and Update writes both at once.
audit.empty: Nothing is read from the database until a buyer is loaded.
audit.no_checks: No checks yet — add the first one.

sc.title: S/C Party Wise Rate Entry
sc.hint: A subcontract party’s quoted rates for one rate group. Pick the group on the left, fill the header, add a rate per line, and Save writes the document and its lines together.
sc.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
sc.auto_placeholder: Left blank, the server issues one
sc.auto_hint: Tick Auto? and the number is issued on save.
sc.detail_hint: One line per rate head. The heads offered are the ones filed under the rate group above.
sc.no_lines_text: A quotation with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
sc.docs_hint: The papers the quotation arrived with, recorded by name. This application has no document store behind it, so the register says which paper exists rather than holding a copy of it.
sc.no_docs_text: Name each paper the quotation arrived with and Attach it.
sc.footer: A quotation is a document: raise a new one when a party requotes rather than rewriting the approved rates a costed batch already points at.
sc.line_incomplete: Pick the rate head and enter its rate before adding.
sc.head_taken: That rate head is already on the quotation.

f.is_default_hint: Proposed on a new batch. Ticking it here clears it from whichever method had it.
f.machine_no_hint: As it is painted on the machine — the whole dye house calls it by this.
f.country_hint: Where the machine was built, not who supplied it.
f.location_hint: The shed the machine stands in. Maintenance is dispatched to it.
f.capacity_hint: Batch weight the machine takes, in the unit chosen beside it.
f.efficiency_hint: What the planner discounts the nameplate capacity by.
f.status_hint: Whether the machine is still on the books. Withdrawn machines stay on file.
f.is_sample_hint: Tick where sample batches may be run on it.
f.employee_name_hint: Left blank, the person’s own name is used.
f.pass_code_hint: Four to six digits. No two people may share one.
f.pass_code_keep: Leave blank to keep the current code.

master.in_use: This entry is still in use; switch it off instead of deleting it.
master.machine_taken: This machine number is already in use.
master.pass_code_digits: The pass code is four to six digits.
master.pass_code_taken: This pass code belongs to someone else.
master.code_taken: This code is already in use.
master.check_repeated: An item is checked only once.
master.pick_group: Pick a rate group on the left before saving — a quotation is always for one group.
master.needs_lines: Rate Details is needed before the quotation can be saved.
master.line_needs_head: Each line needs its rate head.
master.head_repeated: A rate head appears only once in a quotation.

descriptions.dosing-template: Reusable dosing curves a lab dip and a bulk batch are programmed from.
descriptions.lab-dip-recipe: Dye and chemical recipe worked out for a lab dip against a shade.
descriptions.lab-dip-recipe-view: Read-only view of approved lab dip recipes, searchable by shade.

tpl.title: Detail Template
tpl.hint: A reusable dosing curve. Pick a template on the left to load it, or fill this in for a new one — the agents underneath are dosed in step order.
tpl.group_hint: The shade depth the curve is written for.
tpl.finalize_hint: Until this is ticked the curve is still being written, and no lab dip may be programmed from it.
tpl.agents_hint: One line per dosed agent, in the order the bath takes them. Step numbers are what the curve is read by.
tpl.footer: A template is finalised once its curve is complete. Until then it stays off every lab dip's list, which is what keeps a half-written curve out of a bath.
tpl.entry_incomplete: Give the step number, the dye phase and the agent before adding the line.
tpl.step_taken: Step :n is already on the curve.
tpl.no_agents_title: No agent on the curve yet
tpl.no_agents_text: Fill the row above and Add it — one line per dosed agent.
tpl.delete_text: The template and its agents are removed for good.
tpl.empty: No dosing template has been written yet.
tpl.empty_hint: Detail Template writes the first curve.

recipe.hint: A recipe number carries one option per attempt at the shade — submit a second option under the same number rather than renumbering it.
recipe.note: Saved records are written to PostgreSQL and recorded in the audit trail.
recipe.empty: No recipe has been raised yet.
recipe.empty_hint: Add New raises the first one.

v.name: Template Name is required.
v.name_taken: A template of that name is already on file.
v.step: Every agent needs its step number.
v.step_repeated: Step numbers must not repeat — the curve is read by them.
v.phase: Every agent needs its dye phase.
v.agent: Every line needs its dye or chemical agent.
v.process_phase: Step :step: that dye process is not one of its phase's.

labdip.option_taken: That option of the recipe is already on file — the next attempt is the next option.
labdip.style_other_buyer: Style :style belongs to a different buyer. Pick a style of the buyer named above.

f.name: Template Name
f.recipe_no_hint: One number per submission. A second attempt at the same shade is another option under it.
f.colour_hint: Colour type and colour group are read off the shade, not typed here.

batch.saved_note: Saved records are written to PostgreSQL and recorded in the audit trail.

h.plan_code: Quoted on the programme. Unique across the mill.
h.plan_code_ph: Left blank, the screen issues one
h.plan_date: The day the board opens on.
h.scope: Bulk plans run on the production machines, sample plans on the sample machines.
h.scale: Hours one column of the board covers.
h.cell_width: How wide a column draws, 4–60% of the board.
h.remarks_ph: Why this plan was re-cut, what it supersedes
h.active: A retired plan drops out of the board's Search Plan box; its batches stay where they are.
h.plan_note: Raising a plan does not move any fabric. Batches are pulled onto it, and laid out across the machines, on the board.
h.window_from: The hour the first column starts at.
h.indent_note: The requisition takes its lines from the batch card, so what is called off is what the batch is made of. The store releases against it on the Issue List.
h.indent_batch: The requisition is raised for what this batch card is made of — its lines are copied from the card.
h.dyeing_rate: The shade band the batch is dyed under, which is what it is rated by.
h.programme_note: The programme is raised first and despatched later — its challan columns fill in when the challan that carries it is written.
h.challan_programmes: The party's programmes not yet on another challan.
h.receipt_note: The programmes a return closes are recorded against the challan it came back on — pick the challan and the programmes it carried are the ones being received.
h.transfer_party: Where the goods actually came back from, when that is not the party they were sent to.
h.bill_note: A corrected bill is a revision of the one it replaces: give it the original's number in Ref.Bill# so the store can see what it supersedes.
h.ffab_note: The batch is raised against finished goods, so its requisition is on the finished-fabric store rather than the batch store.
h.sample_indent_note: The requisition takes its lines from the batch card, so what is called off is what the batch is made of. The store releases against it on the Issue List, and the four list buttons are on the Lists tab.
h.schedule: The loading plan the batch runs under. Choosing one files the batch against it.
h.qc_note: One verdict per batch per day. A batch re-checked after rework is checked on another day, and both rows stay on file.
h.qc_batch: Only batches that have run. There is nothing to inspect on a batch still waiting for a machine.
h.shade_ph: Matches approved lab dip, 4-5 grey scale
h.sample_note: What is drawn comes off the bulk batch in the same transaction, so the two always add up to what was planned.
h.transfer_no: The server issues it, so two desks drawing a sample at once cannot settle on one number.
h.bulk_batch: The bulk batch the sample is drawn off. Its weight is reduced by what is taken.

board.title: Batch Plan Board
board.hint: Machines down the side, the clock across the top. Pick a plan, then place each batch on the machine and the hour it runs.
board.no_match: No plan matches those two boxes. Raise one with New Plan.
board.no_plan_hint: Choose a plan in Search Plan, or raise one with New Plan. Company/Party and S/B narrow the list.
board.rule: A machine runs one batch at a time, so two bars may not overlap on a row, and a batch heavier than the machine's capacity is refused. Clearing a bar hands the hours back and returns the batch to the strip below.
board.no_machine_hint: This plan's batches run on machines the register has none of yet. Register one on Dyeing Machine Profile first.
board.waiting_hint: Batches pulled onto this plan that no machine has hours booked for yet. A batch booked outside the window is not here — it has a machine and a time already.
board.all_laid: Every batch on :code is laid out.
board.view_saved: The board opens on this view now.
board.pull_hint: A released Fabric Batch Plan is cut into one card per batch it counts; a card already raised by hand, off finished fabric or by a split joins as it is.
board.picked: Picked :no — now click the hour on a machine.
board.no_pullable: Nothing to pull: no released Fabric Batch Plan and no card on no plan.

split.title: Batch Card Split
split.hint: Pick the batch on the left, say how much of each item moves onto the new card, and Save writes the new batch and reduces the original in one transaction.
split.plan_qty_hint: What moves onto the new card. The original keeps the rest.
split.grey_hint: Knit fabric moving onto the new card, by the kilo. Add a line per item, at no more than the original carries.
split.cc_hint: Collar and cuff moving onto the new card. Counted in pieces and issued in both pieces and kilos, so both are recorded.
split.trims_hint: Dyeable trims moving onto the new card, in yards and kilos.
split.no_lines_hint: A split with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
split.footer: The new card takes a new batch number, its own lot and its own machine. What moves comes off the original in the same transaction, so the two cards always add up to what was planned.
split.pick_first: Pick the batch to split on the left first.
split.no_choices: No records to choose from yet.
split.line_incomplete: Pick the item and say how much moves.
split.item_taken: That item is on the split already — change its line instead.

issue.title: Issue against :no
issue.hint: What the batch store releases for this requisition, line by line off the grey ledger. A weighed roll leaves whole.
issue.no_lots: No grey is on this batch in the batch store yet.

g2l.title: Fabric Transfer to Leftover
g2l.hint: Fabric still on a finished batch, which no order has a claim on any more. Tick what is going to left-over, set the weight, and Make Transfer writes it.
g2l.empty_hint: Rows appear here as the system records them.
g2l.footer: :n rolls. Only what is ticked is transferred. The weight offered is what the line has left — transfer less if some of it is still wanted.
g2l.remark: Batch end — moved off the batch to left-over (Dye House).

screens.order-wise-grey-fabric-trans-from-batch-: Order-Wise Grey Transfer from Batch Store

descriptions.dyeing-batch-plan: Machine-wise batch plan for the shift, by shade and fabric type.
descriptions.grey-fabric-requisition-bulk: Grey fabric called off the batch store against a bulk batch.
descriptions.grey-fabric-requisition-issue-list-bulk: What the batch store actually issued against each bulk requisition.
descriptions.batch-card-split: One batch card divided across machines or shades after planning.
descriptions.sc-pre-treatment-program-heat-set-etc: Heat-setting and other pre-treatment sent out to a subcontractor.
descriptions.sc-pre-treatment-challan: Challan covering fabric despatched for subcontract pre-treatment.
descriptions.sc-pre-treatment-program-receive: Pre-treated fabric received back, with quantity and loss booked.
descriptions.sc-pre-treatment-bill: Subcontractor bill for pre-treatment, priced off the rate card.
descriptions.dyeing-batch-src-f-fab: A batch raised against finished fabric rather than grey — re-dye and shade correction.
descriptions.order-wise-grey-fabric-trans-from-batch-: Grey fabric moved between orders while it sits in the batch store.
descriptions.dyeing-color-transfer-replace: A planned batch reassigned to a different colour before it runs.
descriptions.batch-transfer-to-left-over: Fabric released from a cancelled or short batch into left-over stock.
descriptions.gray-2-leftover-transfer-batch-end: Grey fabric still uncut at batch end, transferred to left-over.
descriptions.manual-batch-for-dyeing: A batch keyed in by hand where the plan could not produce one.
descriptions.grey-fabric-requisition-sample: Grey fabric called off the store against a sample batch.
descriptions.grey-fabric-requisition-issue-list-sampl: What the store issued against each sample requisition.
descriptions.batch-production-sample: Output of a sample batch, machine and shade wise.
descriptions.dyeing-finishing-qc-sample: Shade, hand-feel and GSM checks on a finished sample batch.
descriptions.sample-batch-from-bulk: A sample drawn out of a bulk batch rather than dyed on its own.

req_kind.SAMPLE: Grey Fab Req for Sample Batch
req_kind.BULK: Grey Fab Req for Bulk Batch

v.fp_not_released: :no is not released yet — only a released Fabric Batch Plan is cut into cards.
v.fp_carded: :no has been cut into cards already.
v.plan_code_taken: A plan with that code is already on file.
v.code_chars: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore only.
v.cell_width: Cell Width(%) must be between 4 and 60.
v.plan_has_batches: :code has batches on it — clear them off before deleting the plan.
v.manual_ref: Manual Batch Ref. No is required.
v.manual_ref_taken: That reference has a batch already.
v.batch_qty: Batch Qty must be more than nothing.
v.batch_called_off: :no has been called off — its requisition stands.
v.batch_issued: :no has had fabric issued against it.
v.batch_empty: That batch card has nothing on it to call off.
v.indent_issued: :no has had fabric issued against it, so it stays.
v.delivery_before_issue: Exp. Delivery Date cannot be before the Issue Date.
v.programme_on_challan: :no is on a challan already — change it there.
v.programme_unknown: One of the programmes is no longer on file.
v.challan_party_fixed: The challan carries programmes of its party — take them off before changing the party.
v.challan_received: :no has been received back, so it stays.
v.challan_other_party: Challan :no was not sent to this party.
v.bill_taken: Bill :no is already filed for this party under that revision.
v.ref_bill_unknown: :no is not one of this party's bills.
v.same_order: To Order# must differ from From Order#.
v.over_card: Batch Qty cannot be more than :no carries (:qty kg).
v.trns_qty: Trns Qty must be more than nothing.
v.pull_what: Pick a Fabric Batch Plan or cards to pull.
v.cannot_pull: :no cannot be pulled onto this plan — it is closed, of the other S/B, or on another plan.
v.hours: Hours must be more than nothing.
v.machine_scope: :mc is not a machine of this plan's S/B.
v.over_capacity: :no weighs :qty kg — more than :mc takes (:cap kg).
v.split_plan_qty: New Batch plan Qty is required.
v.split_card_qty: New Batch Card Qty is required.
v.split_lines: A split with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.split_whole: A split leaves something on the original: :what is :qty.
v.split_over: More of :item than the original carries (:have).
v.issue_qty: An issue is more than nothing.
v.issue_over_req: More than :no asks — :left kg is left to issue.
v.issue_lot: That stock line is not on batch :no.
v.issue_over_lot: More than the line holds (:have kg).
v.leftover_not_batch: That stock line is not on a batch.
v.leftover_same_store: The left-over store is the one the fabric is in already.
v.fp_on_sample: A Fabric Batch Plan is bulk — pull it onto a bulk plan, not :plan.
v.sample_whole: A sample is drawn off :no, not the whole of it (:qty kg).
v.qc_not_run: :no has not run yet — there is nothing to inspect.
v.qc_twice: :no already has its verdict for :date. A re-check is on another day.
v.loads: A production with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
v.req_other_batch: That requisition is not one of :no.
v.unload_before_load: Load :n: the unload cannot be before the load.
v.production_twice: :no already has a production on :date — put it back on a machine as another load of that one.

prod.title: Sample Batch Production
prod.hint: Find the batch on the left — the scan box searches the same list a barcode reader types into. Its details fill in, and what the floor records is the weight, the machine, the ratio and the loading history.
prod.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
prod.batch_ph: Scan or pick one on the left
prod.req_hint: The grey fabric requisition this batch came in on, where there was one.
prod.weights_hint: What went onto the machine. The card carries what was asked for.
prod.no_choices: No records to choose from yet.
prod.show_recipe_hint: The approved lab dip recipe the shade is being matched to.
prod.no_recipe: No lab dip recipe is on file for this buyer and shade.
prod.fabrics_hint: What the batch card says this batch is made of. Read here, written on the card.
prod.nothing_loaded: Nothing to show here until a record is loaded.
prod.history_hint: One row per load. Duration is worked out from the two times, so correcting an unload cannot leave a duration beside it saying something else.
prod.no_loads_hint: A production with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
prod.footer: One production per batch per day. A batch put back on a machine the same day is another load on the history below, not another production.
prod.pick_first: Find the batch on the left first.

lists.hint: Read from the records at this moment.
lists.empty: Nothing on file in that span.

ed.hint: The header is the document and the grid is what it asks the store for. The requisitioned total is the sum of the lines, never a box typed beside them.
ed.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
ed.req_no_hint: Allocated by the server inside the write, so two desks raising at once cannot settle on one number.
ed.raised_for_hint: The store issues against every kind, so this desk has to say which one it is raising.
ed.req_type_hint: The store's own wording, printed verbatim on the register.
ed.process_hint: What the batch is going back for — Re-Matching, Re-Wash.
ed.store_hint: The chemical sub-store the requisition draws on.
ed.no_choices: No records to choose from yet.
ed.lines_hint: What the store is being asked for. The requisitioned total is these lines added up.
ed.no_lines_hint: A :kind requisition with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
ed.no_lines_any: A requisition with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
ed.footer: The store releases against this on the Print Chemical Requisition desk.
ed.footer_rp: A re-process is raised waiting on approval. The store cannot issue against it until the approval desk has said yes.
ed.line_incomplete: Pick the item and give the required quantity.

ap.approve_text: The batch may be re-processed. The dye, water and machine time it takes are charged to the re-process rather than to the original batch. — :no. The decision is recorded in the audit trail.
ap.reject_text: The batch may not be re-processed, and the requisition is cancelled. — :no. The decision is recorded in the audit trail.

is.title: 10-Issue this requisition?
is.text: The store is recorded as having released the full requisitioned quantity, on every line. A requisition already fully issued cannot be issued again. — :no. The decision is recorded in the audit trail.

crr.back_text: The roll goes back for re-processing, and the return is no longer edited.

h.return_no: The server issues it inside the write, so two desks cannot settle on one number.
h.not_ok: The day QC failed the roll. Earlier than the return, and the gap is what the register reports.
h.defect_ph: Rib shade not OK against body
h.crr_note: Raising the return does not send the roll anywhere. Back does that, from the register — and a roll already sent back stops being editable.
h.problem_time: When the machine actually stopped. Usually before it was reported.
h.resolved_time: When it ran again. Left blank while the job is open.
h.mm_note: Downtime is worked out from Problem Time and Resolved Time, so it is never a third number that can disagree with them.

req.saved_note: Saved records are written to PostgreSQL and recorded in the audit trail.

descriptions.requisition-for-dc-for-batch: Dyes and chemicals requisitioned against a planned batch.
descriptions.requisition-for-dc-machine-wash: Dyes and chemicals drawn for a machine wash between shades.
descriptions.requisition-for-dc-finishing-process: Chemicals drawn for softening, stentering and other finishing.
descriptions.reprocess-approval: Sign-off required before an off-shade batch may be re-processed.
descriptions.update-reprocess: Amend an approved re-process — method, addition or machine.
descriptions.dyeing-reprocess: The re-process itself, with the extra dye and chemical it cost.
descriptions.dyeing-mc-maintenance: Machine downtime raised against maintenance, planned or breakdown.
descriptions.print-chemical-requisition: The store copy of a chemical requisition, printed for issue.

v.process_type: Process Type is required for a re-process.
v.lines: A requisition with no items asks the store for nothing. Add at least one line.
v.line_qty: Every line needs a required quantity above nothing.
v.closed: :no has been issued or decided — it reads only.
v.issued_stays: :no has stock issued against it, so it stays.
v.awaiting_approval: :no waits on the approval desk — the store cannot issue against it yet.
v.qty: Qty must be more than nothing.
v.not_ok_after: Not Ok Date cannot be after the Req Date.
v.sent_back: :no has been sent back — it reads only.
v.resolved_before_problem: Resolved Time cannot be before the Problem Time.
v.resolved_needs_time: A resolved job says when the machine ran again — give the Resolved Time.

chem.saved_note: Saved records are written to PostgreSQL and recorded in the audit trail.

h.ob_note: One row per lot per store. The same lot entered twice would be a double count nobody finds until the drum runs out.
h.auto_lot: Tick where the drum carries no lot number of its own and the store has to give it one.
h.lot_once: Blank only when Auto? is ticked.
h.total_qty: What the store counted. Left blank it is worked out as packs × qty per pack, plus the loose — but a counted figure that differs is kept as counted, because that is what was signed.
h.ob_rate: The rate the opening valuation was struck at. Kept on the row, so a later rate change cannot silently re-value last year's opening.
h.loan_ob_note: One position per supplier per item, carrying both directions — a supplier who lent us some and borrowed some back has one net account, not two.
h.loan_received: Lent to us, and not yet given back.
h.loan_issued: Lent by us, and not yet returned.
h.is_final: Both sides have agreed the figure. A finalised position stops being editable.
h.closing_note: Closing locks the month against further posting. Anything still open in it is listed rather than silently included — finish those first.
h.period: The month being locked. Both 2026-07 and Jul/2026 are accepted.

stock.empty: No stock line has been raised yet.
stock.empty_hint: Stock appears here once an opening balance is saved or a receipt is finalised.

close.empty: No month has been closed yet.
close.empty_hint: A closed month is listed here with its closing balance.

ed.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
ed.no_hint: Allocated by the server inside the write, so two desks cannot settle on one number.
ed.no_choices: No records to choose from yet.

rc.hint: The supplier challan on the left of the header, the drums it arrived with underneath. Both are saved together — a receipt with no lines books nothing in.
rc.source_hint: Imports arrive under a letter of credit; a local purchase has none.
rc.lines_hint: One line per lot. Two drums of the same chemical from different batches are two lots, and the store counts them apart.
rc.no_lines_hint: A receipt with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
rc.line_incomplete: Pick the item, give its lot number and the quantity.
rc.footer: Nothing is counted into stock until the store finalises the receipt on the register. That is the step that adds the drums to the shelf.
rc.footer_back: A party sends back no more of an item than it owes us. Nothing is counted into stock until the store finalises the return on the register.

supplier_hint.LOAN_IN: Who lent us the drums. What we owe them grows by this receipt once it is finalised.
supplier_hint.LOAN_BACK: The party returning what we lent them.

rt.title: Return to Supplier
rt.hint: The receipt the goods came in on, and the drums going back. Picking the receipt fills the supplier and the store, because they are the receipt's own.
rt.mrr_hint: A return with no receipt behind it is stock leaving a store it never entered.
rt.no_mrr: No finalised receipt to return against yet.
rt.lines_hint: What is leaving, lot by lot. It comes off the store's stock once the return is finalised.
rt.select_line: -- Select a lot of the receipt --
rt.no_lines_hint: A return with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
rt.line_incomplete: Pick a lot of the receipt and give the quantity going back.
rt.footer: Nothing comes off stock until the return is finalised on the register — raising the challan is not the same as the lorry leaving.

is.hint: The header says what the chemicals are for; the grid says what leaves the shelf. The required total is the sum of the lines, never a box typed beside them.
is.req_type_hint: The store's own wording, printed verbatim on the register.
is.transfer_hint: Which pair of stores the transfer runs between.
is.gate_pass_hint: Written by the security desk when the drum leaves the building. Blank until then.
is.reprocess_hint: Ticked, the dye and water are charged to the re-process rather than to the first dyeing.
is.lines_hint: What is being asked for, lot by lot — or, with no lot, from the soonest to expire. What actually leaves is set when the store issues against it on the register.
is.no_lines_hint: An issue with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
is.line_incomplete: Pick the item and give the required quantity.
is.line_incomplete_sale: Pick the item and give the required quantity and its rate.
is.footer: Nothing comes off stock until the store issues against this on the register.
is.footer_sale: A sale is the same stock movement every other issue is — chemicals leave and do not come back. What differs is that money comes the other way.
is.footer_transfer: A transfer lands as stock in the receiving store rather than being consumed — which is why it names two stores, and why Item Stock counts it in both. It is verified before the store issues against it.

reqtype.WASH: Store Requisition for M/C Wash & Finishing

party_hint.SALE: Who bought it. A sale with no buyer is stock that has simply gone.
party_hint.LOAN_OUT: The sister concern or subcontractor the chemicals are lent to. What they owe us grows as the store issues.
party_hint.LOAN_RETURN: Who lent us the chemicals. No more goes back than we owe them.

cs.title: New Comparative Statement
cs.hint: The suppliers' quotations laid side by side for every item, the cheapest marked, and the supplier each item is bought from.
cs.factory_hint: The unit the chemicals are bought for.
cs.mou_hint: The supplier agreement's code, where there is one.
cs.usd_hint: The dollar rate quotes in dollars are priced at.
cs.quotes_hint: Every supplier who quoted. Each gets a column in the grid below.
cs.items_hint: One row per item. The cheapest rate in taka is marked; the chosen supplier must have quoted for it.
cs.no_lines_hint: A statement with no items compares nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
cs.line_incomplete: Pick the item and give the quantity.
cs.footer: A statement is submitted once every item is quoted and its supplier chosen, then approved or rejected; a rejected one comes back here to be reworked.

reg.finalise_text: Every lot on it is counted into the store's stock, and the receipt stops being editable. The step is recorded in the audit trail.
reg.finalise_back_text: The lots come back into the store's stock, and what the party owes us falls by them. The step is recorded in the audit trail.
reg.finalise_rt_text: The lots come off the store's stock and go back to the supplier; the return stops being editable.
reg.verify_text: Accounts agree the receipt as counted. It is marked Is Accounting and reads only from here on.
reg.verify_st_text: The giving store agrees to the transfer and may issue against it. Nothing moves yet.
reg.cancel_rc_text: The draft is cancelled and books nothing in. It stays on the register as cancelled.
reg.cancel_rt_text: The draft return is cancelled and nothing leaves the store.
reg.cancel_is_text: What is still asked is dropped. Anything already issued stays issued.
reg.cs_submit_text: The statement goes to the approver and stops being editable until it is decided.
reg.cs_approve_text: Each item is to be bought from its chosen supplier at the quoted rate. The decision is recorded in the audit trail.
reg.cs_reject_text: The statement goes back to be reworked. The decision is recorded in the audit trail.
reg.cs_close_text: The purchase against it is done; the statement is kept as closed.

dlg.title: Issue against :no
dlg.hint: What the store gives now, line by line — at most what is still asked. A line naming no lot is taken from the soonest to expire.
dlg.nothing: Give a quantity on at least one line.

descriptions.stock-opening-balance: What the chemical store was holding on the day it opened its books, lot by lot.
descriptions.daily-dyes-chemical-receive: Dyes and chemicals received in against a supplier challan — the store's MRR.
descriptions.loan-opening-balance: What each supplier had lent us, and what we had lent them, on opening day.
descriptions.chemical-item-stock: What a store is holding right now, worked out from every movement in and out.
descriptions.daily-dyes-chemical-receive-return: Chemicals sent back to the supplier against a receipt, on a return challan.
descriptions.store-transfer-requisition-and-issue: Chemicals moved from the central store to a sub-store, or between sub-stores.
descriptions.print-chemical-issue: Print chemicals issued against a buyer's style and print type.
descriptions.machine-wash-and-finishing-issue: Chemicals issued for washing a machine down and for finishing.
descriptions.batch-program-issue: Chemicals issued against a batch programme, machine and process.
descriptions.dyes-chemical-sales: Chemicals sold out of the store to another party, priced and issued.
descriptions.chemical-cs: The suppliers' quoted rates laid side by side per item, and who each is bought from.
descriptions.requisition-for-loan-issue: Chemicals requisitioned to be lent out to a sister concern or a subcontractor.
descriptions.loan-return-by-party: Chemicals a party has sent back against a loan we issued them.
descriptions.dc-loan-receive: Dyes and chemicals borrowed in from a party, received on a challan.
descriptions.requisition-for-loan-return: Chemicals requisitioned to be returned against a loan we borrowed.
descriptions.month-closing: Month-end closing balance of the chemical store, locked once run.

v.item: The dye or chemical is required.
v.lot: Lot# is required — or tick Auto? to have the store give one.
v.total_qty: The total must come to more than nothing — give the counted total, or the packs and the loose.
v.ob_twice: Lot :lot of this item is on this store's opening already — the same lot twice would be counted twice.
v.ob_moved: Lot :lot has moved since it was opened, so its opening stays as counted.
v.loan_final: This loan position is final — both sides agreed it, so it is no longer edited.
v.loan_nothing: Give the Loan Received, the Loan Issued, or both.
v.loan_twice: This supplier already has a position for this item — one net account, not two.
v.month_closed: :period is closed — the chemical store takes no more movement in it.
v.short: Only :have of :item:lot is in :store — :need was asked.
v.kind: Which paper this is is required.
v.lines: A document with no items moves nothing. Add at least one line.
v.line_lot: Every line needs its lot number — two drums from different batches are two lots.
v.line_qty: Every line needs a quantity above nothing.
v.line_req: Every line needs a required quantity above nothing.
v.line_rate: A sale prices every line — give its Rate BDT.
v.not_draft: :no is past draft — it reads only.
v.cannot_finalise: :no is not a draft, so there is nothing to finalise.
v.cannot_verify: :no cannot be verified as it stands.
v.cannot_cancel: :no cannot be cancelled as it stands.
v.verify_first: :no waits on verification — the store cannot issue against it yet.
v.mrr_not_counted: :no is not a finalised purchase receipt — nothing came in on it to send back.
v.return_before: A return cannot be dated before its receipt :no.
v.not_on_mrr: That lot is not on receipt :no.
v.return_more: Only :left of :item lot :lot is left to send back.
v.issue_closed: :no has been verified or issued against — it reads only.
v.same_store: A transfer runs between two different stores.
v.issue_nothing: Give a quantity on at least one line.
v.issue_before: An issue cannot be dated before :no itself.
v.issue_more: Only :left is still asked on that line.
v.cs_closed: :no has gone for approval or past it — it reads only.
v.cs_lines: A statement with no items compares nothing. Add at least one item.
v.cs_usd_rate: Quotes in dollars need the USD-2-BDT rate to be priced in taka.
v.cs_chosen_unquoted: Row :row: the chosen supplier has not quoted for that item.
v.cs_unchosen: :no has an item with no quote or no supplier chosen — finish those before submitting.
v.period_bad: ":text" names no month — write 2026-07 or Jul/2026.
v.period_open: :period still has :count open paper(s) — finish those first: :list

h.param_note: A blank buyer or fabric type is the parameter for every one. One parameter per buyer and fabric type.
h.param_buyer: Blank: every buyer without one of its own.
h.gsm_tol: ± percent the measured GSM may differ from the booked GSM.
h.width_tol: ± percent the measured width may differ from the booked width.
h.shade_tol: The largest colour difference (ΔE) against the approved lab dip.

records.empty_production: No production has been recorded yet.
records.empty_production_hint: Productions written on the Batch Production tab show here.
records.empty_param: No parameter has been set yet.
records.empty_param_hint: Add one on the Add New tab.

sheet.title: Batch Production
sheet.ratio_hint: Written as a ratio, the way the floor writes it.
sheet.bypass_hint: Skips the QC gate. A re-dye of goods already inspected does not go through check roll a second time.
sheet.scouring_hint: Whether the run included a scouring step before the dye bath.

ed.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
ed.no_hint: Allocated by the server inside the write, so two desks cannot settle on one number.
ed.no_choices: No records to choose from yet.

wash.title: Machine Wash Production
wash.hint: Load the wash requisition, then record what was actually dosed. Kilos, grams and milligrams are kept as written and totalled onto one scale.
wash.req_hint: Only wash requisitions that have not been produced against yet.
wash.lines_hint: What went into the bath. Three scales because that is how the operator reads them off — converting on the way in would lose which one was used. Sub Stock and Central Stock are what the stores hold now, and are shown rather than stored.
wash.no_lines_hint: A wash production with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
wash.line_incomplete: Pick the item and give what was dosed.
wash.footer: One production per requisition. The same wash recorded twice would double what the store thinks it issued.
wash.saved: The wash production of :no is saved.

manual.title: Daily Bulk Batch Production
manual.hint: The loads recorded against bulk batches. Fill in the times the machine feed could not report, then save — production hour follows from the two times and is never typed.
manual.empty_hint: Rows appear here as the system records them.
manual.footer: :n loads. Only Load Time and Unload Time are writable. A machine that came off before it went on is refused, because every hour below it would come out negative.

pg.status_hint: Set by the desk. Closed or cancelled, the paper reads only.
pg.fabrics_hint: What is being booked in, by fabric and shade.
pg.trims_hint: Each dyeable trim on the programme, in yards and kilos.

hint.DIRECT: Book fabric straight against one order. The buyer and style are what the booking is for, so both are required.
hint.GENERAL: The dye house's own booking sheet — fabric requested without naming a single order.
hint.TRIM: A dyeing programme for tape, cord and other dyeable trims. Counted in yards and in kilos, because both are how the store issues them.

style_hint.DIRECT: Picking a style fills its buyer.
style_hint.TRIM: Picking a style fills its buyer.

line_incomplete.DIRECT: Give the fabric and its quantity in kilos.
line_incomplete.GENERAL: Give the fabric and its quantity in kilos.
line_incomplete.TRIM: Give the trim and its yards or kilos.

no_lines_hint.DIRECT: A booking with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
no_lines_hint.GENERAL: A booking with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
no_lines_hint.TRIM: A trim programme with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.

footer.DIRECT: The booking moves no fabric; it says what the dye house is asked to dye.
footer.GENERAL: The booking moves no fabric; it says what the dye house is asked to dye.
footer.TRIM: The programme moves no trims; it says what the dye house is asked to dye.

reg.close_title: Close :no out of dyeing and finishing?
reg.close_text: Every open card of the order is closed and takes no more production. It cannot be undone from this screen.
reg.closed: Closed out of dyeing and finishing.

descriptions.batch-production: Live batch output across machines, shift by shift.
descriptions.machine-wash-production: Wash cycles run between batches, and the time they took.
descriptions.daily-batch-production-for-bulk-manual: Day's bulk output keyed in where the machine feed is unavailable.
descriptions.direct-fabric-booking: Fabric booked straight against an order without a batch plan.
descriptions.general-fabric-booking: Fabric booked to the dye house against a booking sheet.
descriptions.dyeing-program-for-trims: Dyeing programs raised for tape, thread and other dyeable trims.
descriptions.check-roll-parameter: GSM, width and shade tolerances a check roll is measured against.
descriptions.dyeing-and-finishing-close: Closes a batch out of dyeing and finishing; no further posting.

v.batch_closed: :no is closed out of dyeing and finishing — it takes no more production.
v.machine: M/C No is required on a bulk production.
v.model_combo: Model/Combo is required on a bulk production.
v.lab_dip: Lab-dip # is required on a bulk production.
v.unload_before_load: A load of :no came off the machine before it went on.
v.wash_lines: A wash production with no lines posts nothing. Add at least one.
v.wash_dose: Line :n doses nothing — give its kilos, grams or milligrams.
v.not_wash: :no is not a machine wash requisition.
v.kind: Which booking this is is required.
v.booking_lines: A booking with no fabric on it books nothing. Add at least one line.
v.trim_lines: A programme with no trims on it dyes nothing.
v.fabric: Every line needs its fabric description.
v.line_kg: Every line needs a quantity in kilos above nothing.
v.trim_qty: Line :n needs its yards or its kilos.
v.paper_closed: :no is closed or cancelled — it reads only.
v.order_of_buyer: That style is not one of the buyer picked.
v.param_twice: That buyer and fabric type already have a parameter.
v.no_cards: :no has no dye card of that scope.
v.still_running: :no still has a batch on a machine (:batches) — unload it first.

h.shade_note: Grey and finished are both recorded, in weight and in rolls, because the approval is read as the gap between them.
h.batch: Only batches that have been on a machine. A shade cannot be approved before it has been dyed.
h.sl_no: Position within the lot. Body, rib and collar are checked separately and can disagree, so each takes its own number.
h.aprv_date: A passed approval left undated is dated today.
h.grey_fin: Grey weight and rolls; finished below.

records.empty_inspection: No roll has been inspected yet.
records.empty_inspection_hint: Rolls received on the Check Roll Inspection tab show here.
records.empty_shade: No shade approval has been raised yet.
records.empty_shade_hint: Add one on the New shade approval tab.

ins.title: Check Roll Inspection
ins.hint: Scan the batch card and the roll, mark what is wrong with it, and receive it from dyeing. A roll with no faults marked passes; one with faults is held against the department answerable for them.
ins.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
ins.roll_hint: The roll is the unit QC works in — a batch of six rolls can have one bad one.
ins.bypass_note: :no ran with Is By-Pass Check Roll ticked — its rolls need not be inspected before the programme is completed.
ins.department_hint: Who is answerable for the faults marked. Required once anything is ticked — a fault nobody owns is one nobody fixes.
ins.will_pass: Nothing ticked — receiving the roll passes it.
ins.will_hold: :n fault(s) ticked — receiving the roll holds it against the department answerable.
ins.footer: Receiving a roll with nothing ticked passes it. Anything ticked holds it, and the hold names the department answerable.
ins.pick_first: Find the batch first — pick one on the left.

reg.complete_text: The batch programme is marked finished. Every QC gate of its batch must have passed — produced, check rolls passed (unless by-passed) and no rib or collar shade still open.

descriptions.check-roll-inspection: The check roll itself — shade, GSM, width and defects recorded.
descriptions.complete-batch-program: Marks a batch program finished once every QC gate has passed.
descriptions.rib-collar-shade-approval: Shade sign-off on rib and collar against the body fabric.

v.batch: Find the batch first — pick one on the left.
v.department: Name the department answerable for the faults ticked.
v.not_dyed: :no has not been on a machine yet.
v.not_programme: :no is not a batch programme or re-process requisition.
v.no_batch: :no names no batch, so there is nothing to complete.
v.gate_not_inspected: No check roll of :no has been inspected.
v.gate_held: :no has rolls on hold (:rolls) — they must pass first.
v.gate_shade: :no has :count rib or collar shade(s) not passed yet.

h.bill_note: A bill naming the bill it revises takes the next revision number. The party's own bills only.
h.ref_bill: The bill this one revises, if it is a revision.

records.empty_bill: No bill has been raised yet.
records.empty_bill_hint: Raise one on the New bill tab.

ed.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
ed.no_hint: Allocated by the server inside the write, so two desks cannot settle on one number.

pg.title: S/C Out House Program
pg.hint: The programme placed with the outside dye house, and the shades it is to dye. The status is set by the desk; going out on a challan marks it despatched, and booking it back into the store in full completes it.
pg.status_hint: Set by the desk. Completed or cancelled, the programme reads only.
pg.shades_hint: Each shade the party is to dye, in kilos. A shade grey has been called off against keeps its place, and its kilos cannot fall below what was called off.
pg.line_incomplete: Pick the colour and give the kilos.
pg.no_lines_hint: A programme with no shades dyes nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.
pg.footer: Grey is called off against the shades on the Dye Batch Programme; the programme goes out on a challan.

rq.list_hint: Live programmes, with what is left of their shades to call off. Pick one to call off against it.
rq.no_programmes: No live programme to call off against.
rq.title: Programme Shades
rq.hint: Call grey off against the programme's shades — no more of a shade than it still asks. The requisition takes its own batch number, and the store issues it on the Grey Fabric Indent List.
rq.line_incomplete: Pick the shade and give the kilos.
rq.footer: Nothing leaves the store until it is issued on the Grey Fabric Indent List.

ch.title: S/C Out House Challan
ch.hint: The programmes going out to the party on one challan. Saving marks them despatched; once anything on it has come back, the challan reads only.
ch.locked: :no has had fabric back against it — it reads only.
ch.programmes_hint: The party's live programmes not on another challan. A programme goes out on one challan.
ch.none_free: This party has no live programme free to go out.
ch.no_lines_hint: A challan with no programmes carries nothing — add at least one.
ch.footer: The fabric comes back first to the floor, then into the store, against this challan.

rc.challan_hint: Its programmes are what can come back on this receipt.
rc.line_incomplete: Pick the programme and give the kilos.
rc.no_lines_hint: A receipt with no lines books nothing — add at least one programme.

hint.FLOOR: The floor's own check of the dyed fabric coming back, before the store will book it in.
hint.STORE: Dyed fabric booked back into the store against the challan — no more of a programme than the floor has received.

lines_hint.FLOOR: What came back of each programme on the challan, as the floor counted it.
lines_hint.STORE: What the store books back of each programme. A programme booked back in full is completed.

footer.FLOOR: The store books in only what the floor has received.
footer.STORE: The store books no more than the floor has received.

descriptions.dyeing-sc-program-batch: Grey fabric called off against a subcontract programme, shade by shade.
descriptions.grey-fab-requisition-list-dyeing-sc: Grey fabric called off against subcontract dyeing programmes, and what the store has issued.

descriptions.sc-out-house-challan-receive: Dyed fabric booked back into the store against an out-house challan.
descriptions.sc-out-house-floor-receive: The floor's own check of out-house fabric, taken before the store will book it in.
descriptions.sc-out-house-bill: Subcontractor bills for out-house dyeing, with the revision trail behind each.

v.shade_kg: Every shade needs its kilos above nothing.
v.shade_called: A shade with :kg kg called off against it stays on the programme.
v.shade_below: Shade :n cannot ask for less than the :kg kg already called off.
v.req_issued: :no has been issued against — it reads only.
v.req_lines: A requisition with no shades calls off nothing. Add at least one.
v.req_kg: Every line needs its kilos above nothing.

v.challan_received: Fabric has come back against :no — it reads only.
v.challan_programmes: A challan with no programmes carries nothing. Add at least one.
v.receipt_lines: A receipt with no lines books nothing. Add at least one.
v.receipt_kg: Every line needs its kilos above nothing.
v.before_challan: A receipt cannot be dated before its challan :no.
v.store_more: Only :left kg of :no has been received on the floor and not yet booked in.
v.bill_closed: :no is completed or cancelled — it reads only.
v.amount: Amount must be more than nothing.
v.ref_other: A revision names one of the same party's other bills.
